companion.exactTextOrSilentPurpose: Its concrete idea is embedded third-party evaluators: independent reviewers working inside an AI company, with access to check safety work and report findings.

outcomes.observation: The module and separate lens/card visibly express capability and inspection as a question, without a policy outcome, safety result or actual evaluator access.
Deep-ink linework, halftone texture and cyan/coral/yellow/light-paper palette fit the bound adult editorial pop-art direction; the neutral bench avoids an official setting.
No people, named character, politician, flag, government building, logo or brand mark is visible.
The module, cable, stand lens, card and bench have coherent support, perspective and shadow; no anatomy is present.
The inspection card carries abstract geometric marks only; no readable generated text, pseudo-text, label, logo or watermark is visible.
The scene uses generic contemporary computing and inspection objects only; no costume, historical prop or retro novelty is visible.
The module represents capability; the lens and card represent checking. No decorative character, official artifact or irrelevant story object appears.
At full 1774 by 887 pixel size, both dominant objects and the chip-to-lens relationship remain distinct in the wide frame.
